reason: Nothing here hits a problem I actually have. It is a nice-looking box with a lab report, but I buy off a creator video that talks about my issue, and this just reads like an ad.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? $30 a month for a single form feels like paying for packaging.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I follow showing a video where it fixes my bad sleep, plus a reason why bisglycinate alone beats the 8-form blends.
